Defined as isolated breast/nipple aplasia, outside the axes; urethral stenosis in 1/2 males is insufficiently established as part of this isolated disorder.
Intellectual and language developmental impairment; strabismus and hypermetropia each in 3/4. PFO without documented functional impairment does not establish cardiac damage.
Benign smooth-muscle neoplasm originating in the colorectal wall.
Cerebral ventriculomegaly and cystic renal disease define the syndrome; each reported in 4/6. Cardiac abnormalities occur in only 1/6.
Isolated inherited hearing loss; associated speech delay reflects hearing impairment rather than independent neurologic damage.

Germinoma arising in the brain; endocrine involvement depends on tumor location and is not established across this umbrella.
Malignant mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm originating in the uterine corpus, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
IgG4-mediated inflammation of the aorta and surrounding tissue; associated asthma is a separate disease, and hydronephrosis occurs in only 5-29%.
Mesothelioma originating in the testicular tunica vaginalis, a reproductive structure outside the axes; mesothelioma histology does not imply pulmonary origin.
Congenital obstruction of the lacrimal drainage system; sinusitis and inflammatory complications occur in only 5-29%.
Inherited rod-cone retinal degeneration with progressive night blindness and reduced visual acuity.
Marrow erythroid disorder with defective hemoglobin synthesis and ring sideroblasts; extrahematologic damage is not shared across most inherited and acquired forms.
Nonsyndromic congenital formation of an additional developed postaxial digit.
Neoplasm of the retromolar oral region; the jaw parent does not establish a primary bone tumor or direct skeletal invasion.
Hereditary structural disorder of the iris pigment layer.
Punctate hyperkeratosis of palmar and plantar skin.
Clonal dendritic/myeloid-cell neoplasm; destructive bone lesions occur in roughly 80% and skin infiltration in 30-40%; pituitary involvement generally falls below 30%.
Acute middle-ear disorder with sterile serous effusion; infection or an immune-mediated mechanism is not intrinsic to the umbrella.
Glyoxylate metabolic disorder defined by renal oxalate deposition, nephrocalcinosis and stones, reported in 80-99%; enzyme deficiency does not itself establish liver injury.

Congenital absence of insulin-producing pancreatic beta cells causes neonatal diabetes; exocrine pancreatic damage is not established.
